common.siteDescription: Daily AI signal aggregation and index presentation

home.signalQueueDescription: Sorted by topic value, source credibility, and publication time, prioritizing changes that impact product, R&D, and business decisions.
home.noMatchDescription: This filter combination has no results. Try switching topics, clearing tags, or using the search page to find historical reports.

workflow.title: OPS LOGIC
workflow.description: The core of the site is not piling up news, but connecting public sources, scoring systems, editorial review, and subscription distribution into a sustainable daily update workflow.

01.title: Fetch Candidates
01.description: Collect RSS, announcements, papers, open source projects, and product updates from the public source pool.

02.title: Unified Scoring
02.description: Rank by actionability, incremental value, impact, credibility, audience fit, and freshness.

03.title: Editorial Review
03.description: Preserve original links, proofread summary wording, remove duplicate transmissions and low signal-to-noise content.

04.title: Publish & Subscribe
04.description: Output web pages, RSS, JSON Feed, and correctable report links.

productTeam.title: Product Teams
productTeam.description: Quickly determine which models, tools, or platform updates are worth discussing in roadmap meetings.

engineeringTeam.title: Engineering Teams
engineeringTeam.description: Track engineering practices, open source projects, and infrastructure changes with primary sources and scoring dimensions.

foundersInvestors.title: Founders & Investors
foundersInvestors.description: Observe commercialization, ecosystem positioning, and capital signals with daily snapshots, without being slowed down by noise.

subscribe.title: Stay Updated
subscribe.description: Integrate the report into your reading flow
subscribe.supportDescription: Supports RSS, JSON Feed, and email distribution needs, suitable for personal readers, team distribution, and internal aggregation tools.

footer.disclaimer: Content is bounded by public sources, editorial review, and correctable records. It does not provide investment, legal, or medical advice.
